Import from a spreadsheet

  1. In Google Sheets or Excel, select your employee rows with the header row and copy them.
  2. Paste below, or choose a CSV file.
  3. Check the preview, then import.

Recognized columns: Employee No., Name, Position, Employee Phone, Supervisor Phone, Duty Start Date, and optionally Site. Other columns are ignored. Without a header row, columns are read in that order. Dates like 03/10/2026 are read day first (3 Oct 2026). Existing employee numbers are updated, not duplicated.
